name: 凶暴化之假面
desc: 装备怪兽的攻击力上升1000，守备力下降1000。这张卡的控制者在每次自己的准备阶段支付1000基本分。或者不支付1000基本分让这张卡破坏。
faq: The payment of 1000 Life Points is optional and the controller of "Mask of Brutality," not the controller of the equipped monster, chooses to pay or not. If you choose not to pay 1000 Life Points, "Mask of Brutality" is destroyed.
